run_realtime_transcribe: run realtime audio transcription by connecting to a vLLM server via WebSocket and streaming transcriptions
build_audio_to_pcm16_base64: build a function that converts an audio file to base64-encoded PCM16 at 16kHz
test_realtime_transcribe: test the realtime_transcribe function with a custom audio path, host, port, and model
run_cli_transcribe: run the CLI realtime transcription client with --audio_path, --host, --port, and --model arguments
summarize_audio_to_pcm16_base64: summarize the audio_to_pcm16_base64 function that loads, resamples, and encodes audio as base64 PCM16
